title: Scroll Ward
html:
Monster drop: Ogre Youth, Ice Troll Brute

How to get it

Teaches Ward, a level-3 Restoration spell. Needs 30 Intellect and Restoration skill 15 to learn and to cast.

Drops from any monster that casts spells, level 18+.

  • Restoration scrolls come from any caster, whatever school it casts.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
